component.name: YouGlideTube
component.summary: A fast, buttery-smooth YouTube client for desktop

description.p: YouGlideTube Desktop is the desktop version of the YouGlideTube Android app: a fast, buttery-smooth YouTube client with the same look, feel and features, rebuilt for the desktop. It needs no Google account and contains no ads, analytics or telemetry. Sign in with Google and your subscriptions, watch history and Watch Later follow your account, just like on the phone.

ul.li: Native video playback with quality and codec choice, chapters, subtitles, playback speed, queues and a mini player
Google sign-in in the app, with multiple accounts
Your home feed from YouTube, subscriptions, watch history and Watch Later from your Google account
YouTube Music with search, artists, albums, playlists and synced lyrics
A Shorts feed, channel pages, comments and live chat
SponsorBlock, DeArrow and Return YouTube Dislike
Downloads of videos and songs, including clip downloads
Imports from YouGlideTube backups, Google Takeout, NewPipe, LibreTube, FreeTube and OPML

description.p: YouGlideTube Desktop is under active development. Features and storage formats may change before the first stable release.

The first desktop release: Google sign-in the Android way, server subscriptions, history and Watch Later, multiple accounts, the server home feed, music session shelves, clip downloads and the Android look with glass surfaces.
